item.title: The people who inspire CBC Massey Lecturer Alex Neve to fight for human rights
item.description: When he was eight, 2025 CBC Massey Lecturer Alex Neve watched his mother fight for daycare in Alberta. It’s shaped how he thinks about human rights. The Canadian lawyer shares the pivotal moments in his life that led to his human rights advocacy — and shines a light on the chorus of people he carries with him.
